title: SC directs RBI/IRDAI on mule accounts & fuel-insurance linkage
summary: SC directed RBI to prepare SOP for mule accounts; RBI's existing tool: **MuleHunter.AI** (with I4C).

items: SC directed RBI to prepare SOP for mule accounts; RBI's existing tool: **MuleHunter.AI** (with I4C).
SC also directed a pilot linking fuel sales to valid third-party motor insurance — uninsured vehicles may be denied fuel; IRDAI + Centre to pilot **ANPR**-based insurance verification.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → MuleHunter.AI (RBI+I4C); ANPR pilot for fuel-insurance linkage.
